title: How should conversation and task state be stored?
description: Propose local SQLite-compatible storage supported by Mastra for conversation and runtime records. Plantool .plan remains the planning source of truth, not a runtime event database. Decide retention, backup/export, forget behavior and the boundary between global preferences and project knowledge before persistence implementation.
why: Propose local SQLite-compatible storage supported by Mastra for conversation and runtime records. Plantool .plan remains the planning source of truth, not a runtime event database. Decide retention, backup/export, forget behavior and the boundary between global preferences and project knowledge before persistence implementation.

recommendation.why: Supports restart recovery without operating a server

decision.rationale: The person commented on MAST-14: “sqlite is fine for now.” This selects the existing local durable database option for the initial local-first prototype; explicit export remains part of the selected option, while retention and forget controls use reversible local defaults and can be refined later.
